title: pedicularis gruina var. polyphylla
intro: Pedicularis gruina var. polyphylla, commonly known as the Chinese Foxglove, is a plant species that belongs to the Pedicularis genus. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis gruina var. polyphylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
